_comment: UTM (QEMU) VM spec for the Linux EUD (Debian/Ubuntu cloud image). Same swtpm-backed TPM 2.0 mechanism as the Windows EUD; see windows11-vtpm.json for the shared caveat.
name: linux-eud

tpm.note: same emulated-EK caveat as the Windows EUD. On Linux, tpm2-tools (tpm2_getekcertificate) can read the swtpm EK cert directly on the guest to confirm the chain the SPIRE agent's tpm_devid attestor will present.

narration: virtual — emulated EK; mechanism identical to real fleet hardware (see README.md)
